page.overview:
Who is Isago?

Isago has an angular face with a strong jawline and troughs under his eyes. He wears the standard attire of a Suna ninja inclusive of a ghutrah, flak jacket and forehead protector.

Isago is most likely a very skilled shinobi since he is the right-hand man to Baki, who plays an important role in Sunagakure's advisory council.

During Gaara's abduction he was seen alongside Baki who was issuing him orders to deploy a pursuit unit to go after Kankurō. After forming the team, they went back to Baki for further instructions and then head out to find Kankurō.
